payload: source-owned compact coefficients and all retained Merkle layers
construction: one original witness and commitment; direct sequential unlinked-file write; no witness rebuild or rehash
restore_integrity: SHA256 of complete source-owned payload before publication

limits: Only parked payload is covered. Capture, immutable keys, local child metadata, PCS scratch and final encoded bytes need separate admission. This is not a total RSS claim or full-block timing.
